description: We propose decorative timber strips on all eight storeys of a forty-unit encapsulated mass timber apartment. The strips cover 20% of each exterior wall on every storey and run continuously from bottom to top. The flame-spread rating is stated as 75. The assembly has no full-scale exterior-wall test and is not one of the prescriptive Appendix D wall assemblies. We want to justify it with our own detail.
known_facts: combustible timber strips cover 20% of each wall per storey
no full-scale wall test or Appendix D assembly route

gold.departure: Extensive vertically continuous combustible cladding replaces the noncombustible-cladding benchmark without meeting a listed permission.

should_cite.why: Contains limited-area, first-storey and tested-wall permissions.
The prescriptive Appendix D alternative is explicitly excluded by the synthetic facts.

must_not_cite.why: Twenty percent per storey and eight-storey continuity exceed the limited-strip options; no tested-wall route is offered.
